key_claims: Senior Bin Ladin aides were active in Afghanistan, planning terror operations or supervising and training recruits.
One associate traveled frequently to the US and tried to arrange US residence for associates.
Bin Ladin's associates often use multiple names, so 'Khaled' may or may not be an alias.
'Khaled' was a relative of Ramzi Yousef and possibly Khalid al-Shaykh Muhammad.
